findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion `children_after - children_before == set()` cannot fail for the regression it names, because the launch path detaches the supervisor — reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:3280-3284 states the supervisor is reparented away from the launching process before the intermediate exits, and dispatch_launch.py:3323 reaps that intermediate with communicate() — so no direct child exists after the call whether the _start_supervisor stub is applied or removed. The comment at tests/test_crew.py:2064 ('a real supervisor is a child of this process that outlives the call') and the evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-is-built/a-plan-review-judges-the-endpoint.html:61 repeat the same premise. The seam itself is still guarded by `assert launches` at tests/test_crew.py:2067, which reddens if the stub is no longer the seam dispatch takes.
